# FDG9060

> DO NOT implement change notification logic in dependency property accessors. Dependency properties have a built-in change notifications feature that is used by supplying a change notification callback to the `PropertyMetadata`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.3.4 Dependency Property Change Notifications.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not an analyzer candidate of its own: change notification in an accessor of a dependency property is code other than the standard code, which FDG9057 reports; whether that code is change notification is judgment, and the validator does not let a rule list another rule's analyzer diagnostic.

## From the book

```csharp
public static readonly DependencyProperty TextProperty =
  DependencyProperty.Register(
    "Text",
    typeof(string),
    typeof(TextButton),
    new PropertyMetadata(
      string.Empty,
      (obj, args) => {
        // property changed
        ...
      }));
```
